description.zh:
主叫侧放音编码，必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3。
description.en:
The caller-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 3 scenarios, in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

> "1,2,3" means the B->X prompt code is 1, the A->X prompt code is 2, and the other numbers->X prompt code is 3.

description.zh:
被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,其他号码被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，其他号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2。
description.en:
The callee-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 2 scenarios, in the order of "A as callee, other numbers as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" means the prompt code when A answers is 1, and the prompt code when other numbers answer is 2.
The ID of the number pool.

description.zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机。
description.en: The area code. Specifies the location of the X number (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no location is specified, a number is randomly assigned nationwide.

description.zh:
绑定类型，取值：

- mode101：客户指定X号码。

- mode102：平台分配X号码。
description.en:
The binding type. Valid values:

- mode101: The customer specifies the X number.

- mode102: The platform assigns the X number.

description.zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

- 0：永不过期。

- 其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效；超过60s后，自动解绑。
description.en:
The expiration time, in seconds. Valid values:

- 0: Never expires.

- Other values: The binding remains valid for the specified duration after the X number is successfully assigned. For example, if set to 60, the binding is valid for 60 seconds and automatically unbound after that.
The unique identifier of the message request.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度。
description.en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in call record receipt messages. The value cannot exceed 100 characters.

description.zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。
description.en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format.

description.zh:
接通后主叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,其他号码被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，其他号码被叫为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2。
description.en:
The post-connection caller-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 2 scenarios, in the order of "A as callee, other numbers as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" means the caller-side prompt code when A is the callee is 1, and the caller-side prompt code when other numbers are the callee is 2.

description.zh:
固话AXN隐私号的A号码。


> - A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
> - 如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用[UpdateAxnBindFixedLine](~~2883049~~)接口进行修改。
description.en:
The A number of the fixed-line AXN private number.


> - The A number can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code without a hyphen between the area code and the number.
> - To modify a bound number, call the [UpdateAxnBindFixedLine](~~2883049~~) operation.
The N number of the fixed-line AXN private number.

description.zh:
固话AXN隐私号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号。

> 客户指定X号码模式下（即BindType参数为mode101），本参数必填。
description.en:
The X number of the fixed-line AXN private number. The X number is a private number that you purchased in the console.

> This parameter is required when the customer specifies the X number (BindType is set to mode101).

description.zh: 业务时间戳，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒。
description.en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds.

title.en: Bind a fixed-line AXN private number

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台购买隐私号。您可以使用此接口给固话AXN隐私号绑定号码，控制台暂不支持固话AXN隐私号绑定。

- 绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色。例如：在二手车信息发布场景中，A是房东或经纪人联系方式。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have purchased private numbers in the console. Use this operation to bind numbers for fixed-line AXN private numbers. The console does not support binding fixed-line AXN private numbers.

- Before binding a number, determine the role of A in your business scenario. For example, in a used car listing scenario, A is the contact number of the landlord or agent.
